title: Chapter 447
text:
Its enormous body blocked all vision. Compared to it, Han Xiao was extremely small, like the difference between a sparrow and an elephant.

The invisible psychic power that wrapped around Han Xiao did not have any intention of attacking. It seemed like the Interstellar Beast only wanted to drag Han Xiao in front of it and observe him curiously. The attack just now was like a tickle to the Interstellar Beast.

In mid-air, two rows of propulsion nozzles appeared on the back of Han Xiao's mechanical suit. Turbulent airflow gushed out, and the acceleration allowed him to break free from the psychic power's control. The electromagnetic scythe unfolded instantly and slashed at the Interstellar Beast's tentacle.

Clang!

The scythe slashed on the crystal and created dazzling sparks. The Interstellar Beast's tentacle suddenly shrunk, and its body wrinkled. Its vital part was hit, and its posture was distorted.

This slash dealt almost 1,000 points of damage. Compared to its tough body, the tentacle had almost no resistance.

Suddenly, the light on the Interstellar Beast's tentacle suddenly increased by dozens of times, like a flash bomb that exploded out of nowhere. It was extremely dazzling and filled the entire underground cave. Han Xiao and Herlous' mechanical suit's vision turned white. Before they could adjust, a huge force suddenly hit them. The two of them were pushed away, and their backs slammed into the cave wall.

Boom!

The shockwave caused by the psychic power explosion reverberated in the cave. The lake and the cave shook. Countless rocks fell into the overturned underground hot spring, creating splashes.

"Look, it's angry." Han Xiao twisted his neck and chuckled.

The wrist armor revealed tubes that were flashing with blue light. Compressed orbs shot out and quickly turned into cannons.

Bang! Bang! Bang!

In a split second, a violent metal storm erupted in the cave!

Countless bullets hit the Interstellar Beast's body. The tentacle emitted psychic power and formed a shield, deflecting the bullets.

Herlous jumped up and landed on the Interstellar Beast. Close combat was his forte. The Battleship Slicing Blade spun like the wind. The vigorous energy of the Pugilist surged endlessly. His blade technique was sharp and heavy. He slashed along the Interstellar Beast's spine. Although the strength was no different from a massage to the Interstellar Beast, it was still impressive. The path was aimed at the tentacle on its head.

The Interstellar Beast was extremely agile. It flipped and spun in the air. Herlous wanted to stabilize his stance, but the Interstellar Beast's skin was very smooth. There was no leverage point, not even a hair.

In comparison, Aroshia played a bigger role. After energy transformation, psychic power could not control her body. it could only disturb her energy frequency, which was almost useless. She easily flew to the top of the Interstellar Beast's head and gently held the Interstellar Beast's tentacle.

But in the next moment, the highly compressed energy in her palm exploded with a dazzling light.

Boom! Boom!

The explosions did not stop. The Interstellar Beast was convulsing from the explosions. Just think about it. When your vitals were hit by a boxer like a sandbag, the feeling was indescribable. Han Xiao felt pain just looking at it. If it were not for the fact that the Interstellar Beast did not have any organs to make sounds, he was sure that this Interstellar Beast's cries would be very ecstatic.

You're practically breaking my dick.

After Aroshia entered Grade B, the strength of her Esper Ability skyrocketed. Now that she was the number one damage dealer, she was very useful.

The three of them surrounded the Interstellar Beast and fought passionately. Psychic power kept exploding. Bullets rained down, sabers slashed, and energy blasts chased after the enormous Interstellar Beast and exploded into balls of light.

Hualala!

Although this was only an underground lake, the sound of the battle was like an ocean being overturned.

Lenny and a few other naked Godora people hurriedly climbed out of the hot spring. They leaned against the cave wall and looked up at the battlefield nervously. They could not interfere in the battle between Grade B Supers as they were afraid of being affected.

The battle was intense.

The Interstellar Beast's HP slowly but steadily decreased. Even if it protected its vitals, there would be a time when its defense would be broken. The Interstellar Beast's Psychic power was only limited to pushing and controlling objects. Its attack power was very limited to Han Xiao, so he did not have to worry about it.

Not long after, the Interstellar Beast's HP dropped by fifty thousand, and its resistance dropped. The damage dealt by the three of them suddenly increased, and they fought even faster.

Although space creatures had thick hides and flesh, the Interstellar Beast was not good at fighting. Its combat power could only be ranked at Grade B. This was because it had an extremely high amount of health. Among the countless bosses, the Interstellar Beast's tankiness was one of the best. If the players' damage output was limited, they would be dragged to death by the Interstellar Beast. That was because energy and stamina were limited.

The three of them dealt a lot of damage, but after fighting for a long time, their energy and stamina kept decreasing.

Bang!

The battle lasted for a long time. When the Interstellar Beast's HP was only left with five percent, it could no longer stay in the air and fell into the hot spring, creating huge waves.

Han Xiao gestured to Herlous, and the two of them dove into the lake. After searching for a long time, they finally found the dying Interstellar Beast at the bottom of the lake. They caught this monster, and the mechanical suit was operating at full capacity to provide the maximum output, slowly dragging it to the shore.

Its huge body was torn open, and purplish-blue mucus flowed out. Its tentacles were dim and full of cracks. The Interstellar Beast wriggled on its last breath. After Han Xiao confirmed that this thing did not have the strength to continue fighting, he let out a sigh of relief and shook his arms to relieve the soreness in his muscles.

Although he had the mechanical suit protecting him, his bones were still hurting from being thrown around by the Interstellar Beast.

"Huff, huff …" Herlous took off his helmet, and his hair was wet with sweat. He held his knees and panted. "This guy is too tough. I'm so tired …"

Aroshia's body was much dimmer. She had used up more than eighty percent of her energy.

Han Xiao looked at the interface. He still had a lot of HP, but his stamina and energy were almost depleted. After retrieving all the cannons, he counted that he had lost more than twenty cannons. They were all crushed by the Interstellar Beast's psychic power.

"You guys took care of it!"

Lenny and the others walked over with shock on their faces.

Han Xiao turned around and frowned. "Where are your clothes? Also, you guys are not the only missing Investigators. Where are the others? "

"Our clothes were all taken off by this monster," Lenny said. "It probably thought that those were our weapons. We were usually pressed to the bottom of the lake by this monster. Maybe it took us as trophies."

"Go get them. Put on your clothes first."

Han Xiao glanced at them and did not react.

Only sissies like to look at women. Real men should f * ck robots!

He turned around and saw Herlous staring at Lenny. Han Xiao immediately patted him and said unhappily, "Don't stare at her. That's my employer's wife. I don't want to not get paid."

Herlous scratched his head. Before he could say anything, Lenny smiled flirtatiously.

She was in a good mood after being saved. She blinked and smiled. "It's okay. We Godora people are very open-minded. You guys saved my life. Maybe …"

"Stop, I'm not interested in gold."

Han Xiaoxin's heart trembled.

What the f * ck, is she so unrestrained?

Brother Nereja, you're so green!
